facts.Focus: Deep tech: bio, chemistry, materials, energy, food, AI, healthcare
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: Pre-seed SAFE; exact terms offered per deal
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Pre-seed deeptech with demonstrably transformative technology or products.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Biology, chemistry, materials, energy, food, AI and healthcare, with defensible technology, measurable milestones and strong science or engineering teams.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Residency or bootcamp, generally requiring substantial SF participation, for up to approximately six months.
facts.Public Contact Route: Official application; no general email published.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Hardware / Robotics / DeepTech; MedTech / Health / Bio; AI / AI-native; Climate / Energy; primarily at the Pre-seed stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration; Projects without core technology or IP, including undifferentiated apps and trading businesses; Traditional offline businesses without a scalable technology product
facts.Notes: High-priority. Founders from 40 countries; SF bootcamps, labs, fundraising support and targeted investor/corporate intros.
